cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
# Vendored, offline, C-only documents and model-format libraries.
set(_doc_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}")
set(_doc_vendor "${LMX_VENDOR_DIR}")
set(_doc_view "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_doc_view}")
option(LMX_DOCUMENTS_BUILD_TESTS "Build document and model-format checks" ${BUILD_TESTING})
if(NOT COMMAND lmx_c99_target)
    function(lmx_c99_target target)
        set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
        if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
            target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -pedantic-errors)
        endif()
    endfunction()
endif()
include("${_doc_root}/C99Views.cmake")
add_library(lmx_documents INTERFACE)
add_library(LMX::documents ALIAS lmx_documents)
target_include_directories(lmx_documents INTERFACE "${_doc_root}/include")
function(_doc_library name)
    add_library(lmx_documents_${name} STATIC ${ARGN})
    add_library(LMX::${name} ALIAS lmx_documents_${name})
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_documents_${name})
    target_link_libraries(lmx_documents INTERFACE lmx_documents_${name})
endfunction()
_doc_library(pdfgen "${_doc_view}/pdfgen.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_pdfgen PUBLIC "${_doc_vendor}/pdfgen")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_documents_pdfgen PRIVATE _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L)
if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_documents_pdfgen PUBLIC m)
endif()
_doc_library(md4c "${_doc_view}/md4c.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_md4c PUBLIC "${_doc_vendor}/md4c/src")
_doc_library(md4c_html "${_doc_vendor}/md4c/src/md4c-html.c" "${_doc_vendor}/md4c/src/entity.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_md4c_html PUBLIC "${_doc_vendor}/md4c/src")
target_link_libraries(lmx_documents_md4c_html PUBLIC lmx_documents_md4c)
set(_gumbo_sources)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_doc_view}/gumbo")
foreach(_unit attribute char_ref error parser string_buffer string_piece tag tokenizer utf8 util vector)
    file(READ "${_doc_vendor}/gumbo/src/${_unit}.c" _gumbo_source)
    string(REPLACE "#include <strings.h>" "#include \"lmx_documents_strings.h\""
        _gumbo_source "${_gumbo_source}")
    file(WRITE "${_doc_view}/gumbo/${_unit}.c" "${_gumbo_source}")
    list(APPEND _gumbo_sources "${_doc_view}/gumbo/${_unit}.c")
endforeach()
_doc_library(gumbo ${_gumbo_sources})
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_gumbo PUBLIC "${_doc_vendor}/gumbo/src")
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_gumbo PRIVATE "${_doc_root}/include")
_doc_library(yxml "${_doc_vendor}/yxml/yxml.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_yxml PUBLIC "${_doc_vendor}/yxml")
_doc_library(ezxml "${_doc_view}/ezxml.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_ezxml PUBLIC "${_doc_vendor}/ezxml")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_documents_ezxml PRIVATE _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L)
if(APPLE)
    target_compile_definitions(lmx_documents_ezxml PRIVATE _DARWIN_C_SOURCE=1)
endif()
_doc_library(tomlc99 "${_doc_vendor}/tomlc99/toml.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_tomlc99 PUBLIC "${_doc_vendor}/tomlc99")
set(YAML_VERSION_MAJOR 0)
set(YAML_VERSION_MINOR 2)
set(YAML_VERSION_PATCH 7)
set(YAML_VERSION_STRING "0.2.7")
configure_file("${_doc_vendor}/libyaml/cmake/config.h.in" "${_doc_view}/yaml/config.h" @ONLY)
set(_yaml_sources)
list(APPEND _yaml_sources "${_doc_root}/src/yaml_api.c")
foreach(_unit dumper emitter loader parser reader scanner writer)
    list(APPEND _yaml_sources "${_doc_vendor}/libyaml/src/${_unit}.c")
endforeach()
_doc_library(libyaml ${_yaml_sources})
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_libyaml PUBLIC "${_doc_vendor}/libyaml/include"
    PRIVATE "${_doc_view}/yaml" "${_doc_vendor}/libyaml/src")
target_compile_definitions(lmx_documents_libyaml PUBLIC YAML_DECLARE_STATIC PRIVATE HAVE_CONFIG_H _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L)
_doc_library(cgltf "${_doc_root}/src/cgltf.c" "${_doc_root}/src/cgltf_write.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_cgltf PUBLIC "${_doc_vendor}/cgltf")
_doc_library(fast_obj "${_doc_root}/src/fast_obj.c")
target_include_directories(lmx_documents_fast_obj PUBLIC "${_doc_vendor}/fast_obj")
if(LMX_DOCUMENTS_BUILD_TESTS)
    enable_testing()
    include("${_doc_root}/Tests.cmake")
endif()

option(LMX_DOCUMENTS_BUILD_EXAMPLES "Build document-format examples" ${LMX_BUILD_EXAMPLES})
if(LMX_DOCUMENTS_BUILD_EXAMPLES)
    add_executable(lmx_documents_markdown_example "${_doc_root}/examples/markdown_html.c")
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_documents_markdown_example)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_documents_markdown_example PRIVATE LMX::documents)
    add_executable(lmx_documents_pdf_example "${_doc_root}/examples/generate_pdf.c")
    lmx_c99_target(lmx_documents_pdf_example)
    target_link_libraries(lmx_documents_pdf_example PRIVATE LMX::pdfgen)
endif()
